# Skills

One line per setting: NAME — default — meaning. Code anchors and full prose:
`docs/CONFIGURATION.md`. Index: `references/configuration.md`.

- SKILL_CATALOG_INCLUDE_ALL — default: **ON everywhere** — List every skill this session may load in the `<skill-catalog>` short index (one `polyrob-when` line each), so the agent can `load_skill` what the task needs; only pinned skills load at session start. `=false` lists the pinned skills only.
- POLYROB_TRUST_PROJECT_SKILLS — default: **local-mode default: ON**; server: **forced OFF, no env override** — Gate for project-scope skill discovery (`./.agents/skills/`, `./.claude/skills/`, walked CWD->git-root).
